data.why: The repo ships no example document; a short historical-text passage naming people, places, a work, an organization and an event lets a scholar exercise every entity type and the merge/annotate/export workflow.

goals: upload or paste a source text and open it in the editor to begin a new digital edition
mark mentions of persons, places, works, organizations, events and terms and watch each become an entity in the side panel
merge two entities that refer to the same real-world referent by dragging one onto the other
attach an authority identifier (VIAF, GeoNames) and alternate labels to an entity
add annotations to individual mentions and fill in bibliographic metadata for the edition
export the finished edition as TEI P5 XML and confirm it validates against tei_all

review.summary: The tree follows the README's workflow closely: intake, entity marking, merging, authority linking, annotation, metadata, TEI export and document management, with sound depth, faithful labels and screens that mostly match. It needs fixes before filing: it wrongly says the text can't be edited (it is editable and autosaves), it leaves facsimile attachment out of the tree, and a few export and metadata nodes cite screens that don't show what they claim.
